description.value: Sunshine Eatery is a UBC Okanagan campus eatery located on the main floor of the Admin Building, operated by UBCO Food Services as one of 11 on-campus dining locations. It offers breakfast and lunch fare including grab-and-go sandwiches, salads, pastries, hot take-out dishes, and coffee. As a university food services outlet, it primarily serves the campus community of over 12,000 students, staff, and faculty.

address.value: Admin Building (main floor), 1138 Alumni Ave, Kelowna, BC

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (covered, secure) at 79m; wall_loops (covered) at 88m.
